scope: model-level decode dispatch diagnosis; no release timing or quality claim

model_probe.cache: Fresh native cache for each context. Require matching layer offsets and KV shapes before the captured step.
observations: Compare rendered token ID hashes, not just token counts.
Capture attention and quantized pipeline names, grids, dispatch counts and command-buffer grouping.
Preserve receipts for both isolated release-optimized builds; verify model hashes before and after the trace.
